expectations.text: Recommends co-locating a type with the module that owns it as the default (not a central types.ts)
expectations.evidence: 'Define a type next to the code that owns it.' Tier 1: 'Type used by one module → co-locate it in that module's file. This is most of your 400 lines.'

expectations.text: Reframes 'single source of truth' as defined-once, not all-in-one-file
expectations.evidence: 'It means each type is defined once, not that all definitions live in one file. Those are different things, and only the first one actually matters.'

expectations.text: Keeps genuinely shared/global types in a shared or feature-level file (does NOT advise one-type-per-file scattering)
expectations.evidence: Feature-level file for shared types, central file for global primitives; warns 'don't over-correct into a per-type file explosion.'

expectations.text: Grounds it in the agent skipping the cross-file lookup (the central types file is the sibling it won't open)
expectations.evidence: 'A central types.ts is the textbook version of "the sibling the agent won't open."' Agent edits the user and never opens types.ts.
